about: Vanilla HUDMainMenu tiles hidden while the CS HUD is on. Tile names are not yet read from the game's hud_main_menu.xml (this cloud machine has no game files): they must be confirmed on the PC by dumping the HUD tile tree, then verified=true. A wrong name only means that vanilla element stays visible; nothing breaks.

columns.verified: true once the tile name is confirmed and it hides in game
